payload.text: I have twelve months of expenses saved. Offer A pays $210,000, is fully remote, and optimizes opaque engagement tracking for an advertising network. Offer B pays $165,000, is hybrid three days a week, and builds open-source grid-resilience hardware for disaster shelters. Which offer would I probably choose, and what tradeoff would matter most to me?
